excluded_candidates.reason: Verified absent from the September 2026 IMA Master List (candidate_text_misses: ["cesstibtantite"]); discredited and reclassified into hydrokenomicrolite (IMA:2011-103, IMA p. 98) / hydroxycalciomicrolite (IMA:2013-073, IMA p. 98) under the 2010 IMA-CNMNC pyrochlore-supergroup nomenclature revision, neither of which has local primary full-text PDFs on disk.

1982 Shinkolobwe holotype description (Canadian Mineralogist 20:231-238) inspected in Round 121, but held pending full-text acquisition of the 2025 Mineralogical Magazine 89:549 crystal-structure and formula-redefinition paper cited on IMA p. 124.

1978 description (American Mineralogist 63:1162-1165) inspected in Round 118, but held pending full-text acquisition of the paywalled 1979 crystal-structure paper (Yamana, Kihara, & Matsumoto 1979, Acta Crystallographica B35:147-149, IMA p. 222).
